result:
I’d make high-quality education available to everyone—not just schooling, but the chance to ask questions, learn practical skills, and understand the world without cost or circumstance getting in the way.

It wouldn’t solve every problem, but it would give more people the tools to solve the problems that matter to them—and more freedom to choose their own lives.
